messages:
alex: Heads-up — ACME just pushed hard for SSO + tenant routing in our pilot. They said legal will only sign if those land in the initial pilot, not v1.

mia: ugh. that's a big surface. do we have capacity to move sso into MVP?

jordan: Not without trimming elsewhere. SSO is ~2 wks of work (backend + certs + e2e). Tenant routing another ~1.5 wks.

samir: We could lean on a minimal SSO scope: just SAML handshake + basic profile mapping. No fancy admin UI. Saves ~5 days.

alex: Proposal: create an "alternate launch slab" — a narrow pilot MVP variant for ACME that includes minimal SSO + tenant routing, and push some UX polish to v1.

rachel: Sounds reasonable if we lock acceptance criteria. What are the hard cut candidates to defer?

jordan: Deferables: promptstore UI polishing, advanced rate-limiting admin, and per-route cost breakdown on console. Those are non-blocking for the pilot.

mia: Risks: moving SSO to MVP increases security review + KMS scope. Ops will need a runbook for key rotation during pilot. @ops-bot can you flag required infra changes?

ops-bot: @product flagged: needs KMS integration, scoped HSM optional. Also requires updated audit logging to include SSO events. Estimated infra impact: 3 dev-days + 1 oncall day.

samir: If we accept the slab, we should also formalize rollback: pilot-only flags + canary routing so we can revert ACME to hosted default quickly if issues.

alex: Agreed. Action items: 1) Jordan + Samir to draft minimal SSO spec (due EOD Thurs). 2) Ops to confirm KMS/runbook (due Fri). 3) Product to draft Pilot acceptance criteria and sign-off doc (Alex/Rachel, due Mon). 4) PMM to prep messaging for customers if pilot deviates from v1 feature list (Rachel).

jordan: I'll drop a quick spec in #docs and ping here when ready.

mia: One more ask — what's the timeline hit if we go this route vs baseline?

alex: Baseline MVP ship: 3/31. With alternate slab for ACME, public MVP stays same, but we run an earlier pilot with ACME in the slab on 3/17. It shifts internal QA slices but not public launch.

rachel: Good, make sure sales gets a clear checklist of what ACME will see in pilot vs v1. No surprises.

samir: Noted. Also recommend a short eval checklist for quality regressions tied to the SSO flow (latency, error rates, token handling).

alex: Cool. If nobody objects, I'll convert this into a formal decision doc and call the slab approved pending the action items.

mia: +1 from product. Let's keep scope surgical. :scalpel:

jordan: +1 from eng.

ops-bot: Reminder: Please add any infra tickets to milestone MLP-42 for tracking.
